capabilities: Color tasks by a color-name frontmatter property or tag
Set or remove a task color from the right-click context menu
Toggle coloring per view (calendar, agenda, kanban, list, widget)
Keep the calendar event's priority stripe in its priority color
disambiguation: Only colors tasks inside TaskNotes views; it does not color regular Obsidian tasks or checkboxes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it also requires Obsidian 1.13+.
intentEvidence: Requires the TaskNotes plugin and Obsidian 1.13+.
problem: TaskNotes tasks all render with the same appearance, so there is no built-in way to visually distinguish tasks by a color across its views.

relations.evidence: Requires the TaskNotes plugin and Obsidian 1.13+.

summary: TaskNotes add-on that tints tasks with a color from a frontmatter property or tag across calendar, agenda, kanban, list and widget views.
